setup_sphinx_hooks: setup Sphinx event hooks to generate Doxygen XML, copy README, and clean up after build
generate_doxygen_xml: generate Doxygen XML output in the .build directory for Breathe to consume during Sphinx build
prepare_readme_for_docs: prepare README.rst by stripping badges and converting section titles for LaTeX documentation output
clean_up_generated_readme: clean up the generated readme.rst file from the docs directory after Sphinx build finishes
configure_breathe_for_cpp: configure Breathe extension to map .h header files to the C++ domain for pybind11 documentation
